name: fitcheck-fit-verdicts
description: Labelled job and candidate pairs for fitcheck. Each pair is one recruiter interview; the label is the verdict a careful human screener would give from the candidate's notes. All candidates and jobs are fictional.

pairs.rationale: Go and Python on AWS, the serverless Lambda pipeline rebuild, deploy reliability and cross-team mentoring cover every must-have.
Deploy success 71% to 98%, a zero-downtime Lambda pipeline cutover, Datadog dashboards and a three-team API effort.
Built a Python FastAPI and Postgres reconciliation service at a payments company, plus contract tests.
Built RAG over runbooks, an MCP server for doc search and a 120-ticket eval set.
No Swift, UIKit, Core Data or mobile profiling in the notes.
TypeScript is listed, but no React, design system or accessibility work.
Python, SQS and AWS, but no Kafka, Spark, Airflow, dbt or Snowflake.
Strong Terraform and CI/CD, but the notes show serverless Lambda, not Kubernetes, Helm or operators.
LLM evals and RAG, but no model training, model serving or experiment tracking.
